# @perimetre/ui-behaviors

> Behaviours, primitives and utilities Périmètre adds to UI SDK. The app builds its own components from them. Everything here assumes UI SDK's docs and documents only what differs.

Paths are relative to `node_modules/@perimetre/ui-behaviors/`.

## Start here

- [The skill](../skills/ui-behaviors/SKILL.md): the rules, the entries and which reference to read
- [Primitives](../skills/ui-behaviors/references/primitives.md): `magnify`, `sequence`, `locator`
- [Behaviours and utilities](../skills/ui-behaviors/references/behaviors.md): `createFollowPoint`, `createScrub`, `createAutoProgress`, `createLinkedHighlight`
- [Google Places and Google Maps](../skills/ui-behaviors/references/google.md)

## Reference

- The API of every export is the JSDoc in `dist/**/*.d.ts`
- [Updating UI SDK](updating-ui-sdk.md): for maintainers of this package

## Stories

One per entry, next to its source, under `src/`. Each is the shortest working example of its entry.

- `behaviors/follow-point/follow-point.stories.tsx`: a light that follows the pointer
- `behaviors/scrub/scrub.stories.tsx`: a before and after divider
- `behaviors/auto-progress/auto-progress.stories.tsx`: a bar that fills once
- `behaviors/linked-highlight/linked-highlight.stories.tsx`: a chart and its legend
- `behaviors/google-map/google-map.stories.tsx`: the locator with a Google map
- `primitives/magnify/magnify.stories.tsx`
- `primitives/sequence/sequence.stories.tsx`
- `primitives/locator/locator.stories.tsx`: with a map the app draws
- `utilities/google-places/google-places.stories.tsx`: an address field
- `react/icon/icon.stories.tsx`

## UI SDK

- Installed: `node_modules/@ui-sdk/react/docs/llms.txt`, and the skill at `node_modules/@ui-sdk/core/skills/ui-sdk/SKILL.md`
- Online: https://ui-sdk.dev/llms.txt
- Source: `gh api repos/vercel-labs/ui/contents/<path> -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw"`, like `packages/core/src/foundation/direct-manipulation/area.ts`
